registration.kind: Pre-specified replication of two post-hoc logical-evaluator findings on the WikiText-2 validation split; not held-out, unseen-input or confirmatory validation (see input_status); not canonical, not serving, not a deployable policy

input_status.disjointness: no 32-token sequence shared with the full test-split token stream and no shared line of 40+ characters (offline gates)
input_status.recorded_project_use: none found in git history, local files, shell history or available agent transcripts
input_status.why_not_excludable: unrecoverable 2026-05-03 GPT-2 session that downloaded all WikiText-2 splits; transcripts before 2026-09-24, ChatGPT conversations, deleted scripts and remote provider logs not inspectable
input_status.claim_scope: replication only; no unseen-input, held-out or confirmatory claim is made from this run

replication_data.construction: frozen legacy protocol: non-empty stripped lines, 64-line blocks, no special tokens, first 32 x (1024+128) tokens, consecutive non-overlapping windows

registration.selection: All 32 validation-split windows, fixed before scoring, no exclusions and no outcome-dependent selection.

arm_definitions.bf16: Exact K and V native cache
arm_definitions.range_real: K3 excludes artificial padding zeros; frozen V2/META8 and R4
arm_definitions.k_exact: All K exact; frozen V2/META8 and R4
arm_definitions.open_exact: Only unfinished old K group exact; completed K groups padding-exclusion K3; frozen V2/META8 and exact R4
arm_definitions.closed_exact: Only completed old K groups exact; unfinished K group padding-exclusion K3; frozen V2/META8 and exact R4
arm_definitions.rabit: Frozen policy: K3 with zero-padded open group, V2, META8, R4 (canonical)

registration.group_definition: For length N, old=max(N-4,0); completed=[0,32*floor(old/32)); unfinished=[32*floor(old/32),old); residual=[old,N). Reclassify each decode; exact unfinished tokens become quantized when their page closes in open_exact.
registration.controls: Window 1: pass-through equals bf16 and each oracle replay equals its arm, bitwise; same-device oracle checkpoints for every quantized arm
registration.anchors: Canonical WikiText-2 test window 1 for bf16, range_real and k_exact, compared bitwise with attempt 008 (environment fingerprint); excluded from all analysis
registration.intervention: Only incomplete K group padding repeats last real token for extrema; codes/decode and META8 otherwise unchanged; an independently modified packed oracle and separate NumPy reference validate semantics. Padding is never attended.
registration.execution: single H100 80GB HBM3 Pod, scientific retries zero; any rerun repeats this registration byte for byte and every attempt is reported

analysis.decision_interval: two-sided 97.5% percentile (Bonferroni over H1 and H2)

primary_replication_criteria.H1_padding_exclusion_qwen: range_real vs rabit 97.5% CI upper < 0, AND fraction of frozen excess NLL removed, mean(rabit-range_real)/mean(rabit-bf16), has 97.5% CI lower bound >= 0.80
primary_replication_criteria.H2_closed_page_localization_qwen: k_exact vs range_real 97.5% CI upper < 0, AND closed_exact vs range_real 97.5% CI upper < 0, AND closed fraction mean(range_real-closed_exact)/mean(range_real-k_exact) 97.5% CI lower >= 0.75, AND open fraction 97.5% CI upper <= 0.25

secondary.S1_llama_noninferiority: range_real vs rabit 95% CI upper <= +0.5% PPL (no material harm); secondary, not a primary replication criterion

analysis.descriptive: All other contrasts, both models; Llama gap fractions are reported but not interpreted if the denominator interval crosses zero
analysis.thresholds_rationale: Set below the post-hoc estimates (0.949 [0.938, 0.960]; 1.016 [0.913, 1.073]; -0.017 [-0.097, 0.074]) so that the test asks whether the qualitative finding replicates on windows disjoint from those that produced the estimates, not whether its magnitude is matched
analysis.failure_rule: If any validity control or anchor fails, no replication decision is made from the run
analysis.decision_labels: H1 and H2 are each reported as replication criteria met or replication criteria not met, never as confirmed

interpretation_limits: logical evaluator only; serving engine unchanged and not scored
fixed FLASH_ATTENTION backend, not the canonical automatic-backend configuration
exact-K arms are BF16-key diagnostic controls, not deployable policies
both models may have seen Wikipedia text in pretraining; this affects all arms equally and is not controlled
